I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I said I'd noted that he's on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile.

My first reply was wrong. It said his calendar was empty tomorrow, but the calendar I checked was mine, not his, and mine has nothing on Oct 15. I posted a follow-up in the same thread saying I can't confirm his morning is clear and suggesting he check his own calendar.

I also offered to block the morning as travel time or point people to someone else while he's out. I haven't done either, since he didn't ask.
